The store was installed in the basin on 12 June 2026. It was meant to be seen from the shore, and its shelves were stocked with products from several countries. Solar power kept its signs lit after dark. Its realism drew crowds and attention on social media, and because visitors could not go inside, it was nicknamed the "Inconvenience Store".
